title: Teaching
text:
Teaching at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) since 2021, and previously at the University of Klagenfurt, Austria.


Current Courses at NMBU




DAT200 — Applied Machine Learning


NMBU · Spring semester · Annual · 250 hours workload


Introduction to machine learning methodology using modern computing tools. Topics: preprocessing, feature extraction (PCA, LDA), feature selection, visualisation, scaling, and data formatting. Heavy focus on practical applications.




DAT300 — Applied Deep Learning


NMBU · Autumn semester · Annual · 250 hours workload


Builds on DAT200. Covers foundations of artificial neural networks, deep CNNs, RNNs, autoencoders, variational autoencoders, GANs, and transformers. Heavy focus on applications and real-data modelling.




INF221 — Computer Science for Data Scientists


NMBU · Previous course


Foundations of computer science tailored for data science students — algorithms, data structures, and programming paradigms relevant to ML workflows.

title: Fadi Al Machot
text:
About
I am Assoc. Prof. PD. Dr. techn. habil. Fadi Al Machot, specializing in Zero/Few-Shot Learning, Explainable AI, Temporal Data Analysis, and Neural-Symbolic Learning with Knowledge Representation. My research translates into impactful applications in healthcare and assisted living, automotive and ADAS, smart agriculture, and bioinformatics — developing lightweight and context-aware AI solutions that bridge logic, learning, and real-world needs.

Patent · European Research Patent No. EP2790165 — Quality Determination in Data Acquisition (2013), in collaboration with Swarco Traffic Systems, Germany. Award · Best Practice Project Award 2013 — Smart Resource-Aware Multi-Sensor Network (SRSnet).

Fundamental Research Talks


Invited presentations on core research themes: trustworthy AI, neural-symbolic learning, zero/few-shot generalization, and efficient temporal models.



January 2026 · University of Limerick


From Seen to Unseen: Learning Beyond Data Abundance CRT-AI ML Week 2026, hosted by Prof. Tiziana Margaria. Topics: Zero-Shot Learning, knowledge-driven generalization, energy-efficient AI — why scaling data and parameters is not enough for rare and safety-critical scenarios.




January 2026 · Halden, Norway


Panel: Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence 1st International Conference on Human-Centric AI (ICHCAI 2026), Institute for Energy Technology. Topics: Trustworthy AI, explainability, human-in-the-loop systems.




2024 · Kaiserslautern, Germany


Bridging Logic and Learning: Neural-Symbolic Approach for Enhanced Reasoning (ASPER) DCLXVI International Workshop. Topics: Answer Set Programming, neural-symbolic integration, knowledge encoding in deep learning.




2024 · Kaiserslautern, Germany


Symbolic-AI-Fusion Deep Learning (SAIF-DL): Encoding Knowledge into Training DCLXVI International Workshop. Topics: ASP loss penalties, ontology-driven training, trustworthy deep learning.




February 2025 · DTE AICOMAS


Predicting Battery Degradation Using Cellular Neural Network Model Digital Twin Technology for Battery Cell Manufacturing Symposium. Topics: Cellular neural networks, lightweight models, efficient temporal prediction.
